About Funden: Founders think raising capital is a relationship problem. It's actually a preparation and signal problem. Funden builds the infrastructure that makes investors come to founders: a clean, investor grade deal plus a compounding public signal, instead of chasing warm intros that rarely close.

We work with a limited number of pre seed to Series B founders at a time, by application only. We'd rather tell someone we're not a fit before they apply than after. That selectivity is the backdrop for this role. You're not talking founders into something they'll regret.

You're helping serious operators decide whether an institutional grade process is worth committing to. Location: Work from anywhere. Funden operates across San Francisco, New York, and London, and this role can be based wherever you are. Compensation: Commission only, uncapped.

Warm, pre qualified inbound plus the freedom to build your own outbound pipeline. Full commission structure, ramp expectations, and average deal economics are shared transparently on the first conversation. We'd rather you have the real numbers before you invest your time than after.

About the Role: This is a full cycle sales role focused on two things: bringing in new leads and closing the inbound ones. The majority of your pipeline is warm. Founders apply through the site, self select on stage and raise size, and arrive already interested.

You'll run the interview call, pressure test the deal alongside our team, and close the founders who are genuinely a fit. Alongside that inbound engine, you'll do outbound, sourcing founders and referral relationships that match our profile, to keep the pipeline full between cohorts. You own the conversation from first call to signed engagement.

You'll turn away founders who aren't right, because a bad fit close costs us more than a missed one. This is a commission only role. There is no base salary. The trade is straightforward: uncapped earnings, warm and pre qualified inbound, a real product with real outcomes behind it, and the autonomy to run your own pipeline.

If you close, you earn, with no ceiling on how much. Your Role Responsibility:
Run discovery and qualification calls with inbound founder applicants, pressure testing narrative, stage, and readiness against our fit criteria
Close engagements with founders who are a strong fit, and confidently disqualify those who aren't
Source outbound leads: founders and referral partners such as operators, angels, and accelerators matching the pre seed to Series B profile
Own your pipeline end to end, including forecasting, follow up, and CRM hygiene
Translate a nuanced offering (audit, deal materials, and a compounding signal system) into terms a founder can act on
Feed the team real signal from the market: which objections recur, which segments convert, what founders actually respond to

Experienced in a considered, consultative B2B sale, ideally to founders, operators, or finance literate buyers
Comfortable, energized even, by a commission only structure, because you back your own ability to close
Credible in a room with founders and investors; you can hold a substantive conversation about fundraising, deal quality, and what actually moves capital
Genuinely willing to say no to a bad fit deal, and disciplined enough to protect the brand over a short term win
Self-directed: you build your own process, manage your own pipeline, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Experience in venture, startup fundraising, M&A, investment banking, or a founder facing SaaS or fintech sale
An existing network in the early-stage startup or investor ecosystem
You've raised capital yourself, or sat close enough to the process to speak to it with authority

About SafeLease
At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both.

We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), Manufactured Housing , you’ll be an early member of the team responsible for building SafeLease ’s presence within the Manufactured Housing industry.
You’ll own top-of-funnel prospecting to identify, engage, and qualify Manufactured Housing operators across the country. You’ll often be reaching senior and C-suite executives, so success in this role requires more than simply making a high volume of calls. You’ll need to be curious, confident, empathetic, and capable of having thoughtful business conversations with sophisticated buyers.
As one of the first BDRs dedicated to this market, you’ll also have a meaningful role in helping us build the playbook . You’ll test messaging, learn directly from the market, identify what resonates with operators, and share those insights with sales and leadership as we refine our go-to-market strategy.
The ideal candidate is highly coachable, competitive, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited by the opportunity to help build something.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to accelerate their sales career while making an impact from day one. High-performing BDRs will have opportunities for career growth within a company where exceptional performance is recognized and rewarded.

Prospect into Manufactured Housing operators and ownership groups through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels
Identify and engage key decision-makers, including C-suite and senior executives
Navigate gatekeepers thoughtfully and professionally to reach the right stakeholders
Lead with curiosity and empathy to understand how prospects operate today before positioning a solution
Conduct early qualification and uncover enough business context to determine whether an opportunity warrants a deeper sales conversation
Partner closely with Account Executives to create high-quality qualified opportunities and build pipeline
Research target accounts and personalize outreach based on the organization and individual you're contacting
Test different messaging, talk tracks, and approaches and provide feedback on what you're hearing from the market
Maintain accurate prospecting activity and opportunity context within our sales systems
Contribute to the development of our Manufactured Housing BDR playbook as the team learns and scales

You have a strong desire to build a career in sales and are motivated by measurable goals and performance-based compensation
You're genuinely curious and ask thoughtful questions instead of immediately jumping into a pitch
You're a strong listener who can pick up on what matters to a prospect and adjust the conversation accordingly
You're comfortable communicating with senior executives and can be confident without being overly aggressive
You understand that empathy and persistence can coexist and you're willing to keep going without treating prospects like numbers
You're comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and hearing “no”
You communicate clearly and naturally over the phone, email, and LinkedIn
You're resourceful and willing to find creative ways to reach difficult-to-access decision-makers
You're highly coachable and can quickly incorporate feedback into your approach
You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and excited about helping build a sales motion that will continue to evolve
You're collaborative and willing to share what you're learning with the broader team
You're competitive and performance-driven while still being a great teammate
You're always looking for ways to improve your own effectiveness and find new paths to success
Experience
1+ year of sales, business development, customer-facing, or similarly high-accountability experience preferred, but not required
Demonstrated track record of success in a professional, academic, athletic, or other performance-driven environment
Experience with outbound prospecting and/or executive-level buyers is a plus
Commercial real estate or Manufactured Housing experience is a plus, but not required
P&C insurance interest and/or experience is a plus
Why SafeLease ?
The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.
The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.
The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.
The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.
If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.
Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

About The Role Vivid Money is redefining how modern businesses, growing SMEs, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From high-yield Interest Accounts and multi-currency infrastructure to treasury tools and team cards, we provide the modern financial platform that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.
We are expanding our business presence across Germany.
We aren’t looking for an SDR to just follow a pre-written playbook; we are looking for our Founding SDR for the DACH market. Working directly alongside our Founding Account Executive, you will be employee number one on the SDR side, responsible for building the outbound engine from scratch.

Your core focus will be opening doors with SMB decision-makers (CEOs, CFOs, Finance Directors), while strategically mapping and testing outreach to adjacent personas like holding structures, PE/VC portfolio leads, and family offices.
If you want the autonomy of a founding team member, want to write the prospecting playbook, and want to establish the top-of-funnel blueprint for Vivid in Germany, this role is for you.
Your Mission Build the Outbound Engine: Architect, build, and test our cold outreach sequences across phone, email, and LinkedIn targeting SMB decision-makers across Germany.
Map & Test New Personas: Experiment with outreach strategies for secondary personas, including holding companies, VC/PE portfolio managers, and corporate service providers, to help define our expanded ICP.
Generate High-Volume Pipeline: Own top-of-funnel growth by sourcing, qualifying, and booking high-intent discovery meetings for the Founding Account Executive.
Design the Playbook: Partner directly with Sales Leadership to document what works, establishing the framework, templates, and best practices for future SDR hires.
Leverage AI & Sales Infrastructure: Help select, implement, and optimize our AI-native prospecting stack, utilizing AI tools to automate research, trigger tracking, and hyper-personalized messaging.
Continuous Feedback Loop: Gather market feedback from prospect interactions to help refine product positioning, objections handling, and GTM messaging.
Your Profile 1–3 years of outbound prospecting experience (SDR/BDR) in B2B FinTech, SaaS, or financial services, preferably within the DACH market.
Founding/Builder mindset: High agency, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating processes from scratch rather than just executing existing ones.
Persona curiosity: Ability to speak the language of SMB founders and CFOs, with a strong interest in learning how different corporate entities and treasury setups operate.
Tech-savvy & AI-native: Active user of modern sales stacks and AI prospecting tools to maximize outreach efficiency.
Tenacious & resilient: Motivated by raw pipeline creation, testing new angles, and iterating quickly based on response data.
Languages: Full professional fluency in German and English is required.
Why Join Vivid? Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations.
Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities.
AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
Learning & development budget to support your professional growth.
Fully paid vacation and sick leave.

Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.
Compensation range Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.
About Vivid At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.
Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.
Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.
We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making.

This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

You set your own rates, choose your availability, and build your client base by offering value to the students who choose to work with you. We bring the learners to the platform; you decide how you want to show up and grow your presence.
This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy mentoring, want to earn extra income, and like the idea of running their coaching practice with total flexibility.

Prestataire de solutions liées à la mesure et à l-amélioration de l-impact énergétique et environnemental des parcs Immobiliers, Signa-Terre SA réunit les compétences de technologies de l-information, d-architecture, d-ingénierie et de gestion de l-énergie dans le domaine bâti. Depuis 2023 Signa-Terre SA fait partie du groupe Wüest Partner SA.
Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité auprès des régies et des propriétaires, nous recherchons pour notre succursale de Genève, un.une :
**Conseiller.ère en gestion énergétique de patrimoine immobilier | 80 - 100%**
**Envie d-intégrer une entreprise dynamique et créative ?** Rejoignez une équipe où convivialité, partage et responsabilité font partie de notre culture.
Orienté.e service, vous appréciez le contact avec la clientèle et savez instaurer une relation de confiance grâce à vos qualités d-écoute et de communication. Intéressé.e par les enjeux techniques et énergétiques du bâtiment, vous souhaitez mettre à profit ou développer vos compétences dans un secteur en constante évolution.
Rigoureux.se, organisé.e et autonome, vous gérez vos missions avec efficacité et êtes parfaitement à l-aise avec les outils informatiques. Vous êtes au bénéfice d-une formation supérieure ou technique pertinente pour le poste (Bachelor HES/EPF, diplôme ES, CFC avec formation complémentaire ou titre jugé équivalent).
Au-delà de votre parcours, votre motivation, votre engagement et votre envie de contribuer à des projets stimulants feront la différence.
**Vos atouts supplémentaires :**
* Une formation ou spécialisation dans le domaine de l-énergie, des techniques environnementales ou de la technique du bâtiment
* Une expérience préalable dans le domaine du smart metering
* La connaissance du monde de l-immobilier suisse (régies, propriétaires)
* Vous êtes bilingue (allemand, suisse allemand / français)
**Votre job au quotidien :**
Vous évoluerez au sein d-une équipe dynamique accompagnant des propriétaires et régies immobilières dans le suivi énergétique de leurs bâtiments, la réduction de leurs émissions de CO2 et l-atteinte de leurs objectifs de durabilité.
Vous serez responsable de la gestion d'un portefeuille de bâtiments variés situés dans toute la Suisse romande et assurerez notamment les tâches suivantes :
* La mise en place et le suivi administratif de nouveaux mandats et immeubles ;
* Le contrôle, la validation et l-analyse des données de consommation de l-ensemble des flux énergétiques (mazout, gaz, électricité, eau chaude sanitaire, solaire et eau) ;
* L-établissement et l-analyse de bilans énergétiques ainsi que l-identification des anomalies de consommation ;
* La rédaction de rapports de surveillance énergétique ;
* La présentation aux clients des bilans énergétiques, des rapports d-analyse et des recommandations d-amélioration.
En complément, vous pourriez également être amené.e à accompagner nos clients dans la définition de leur stratégie ESG, assurer leur formation à l-utilisation de nos solutions et leur présenter régulièrement les nouvelles prestations et évolutions proposées par l-entreprise.
**Nous vous proposons :**
* Une entreprise où convivialité, partage et responsabilité font partie de l-ADN
* Une structure créative, dynamique et en constant développement
* L-utilisation d-outils innovants
* Un poste à 80 ou 100 %
* Des formations sur le monde de l-énergie, la gestion du domaine bâti ainsi que sur nos propres outils d-analyse technique et énergétique
**Quand commencez-vous ?**
Dès que possible, selon vos disponibilités.
**Candidature :**
Veuillez envoyer votre CV, une lettre de motivation ainsi que les documents usuels via JobUp uniquement.
Nous nous réjouissons de vous lire !

## Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich **Verkauf** suchen wir per **01.10.2026**, befristet bis zum **31.12.2026**, am Standort **Chur**, eine\*n motivierte\*n und engagierte\*n **Mitarbeiter\*in Verkauf Papeterie/Multimedia, 70%**. ##
**Deine Verantwortung**
* Du führst eine professionelle Kundenberatung durch und bereicherst mit aktuellem Knowhow das Einkaufserlebnis unserer Kunden.

* Du bewirtschaftest und präsentierst unser Sortiment ansprechend und kundenorientiert.
* Du bist für die Ordnung und Sauberkeit auf der Verkaufsfläche verantwortlich.
**Dein Profil**
* Du verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene Grundausbildung im Detailhandel im erwähnten Bereich mit.
* Du bringst bereits umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in einer gleichwertigen Tätigkeit mit.
* Du hast Spass am Verkaufen und ein Gespür für unsere anspruchsvollen Kunden.
* Du bringst eine Leidenschaft den Bereich mit und verfolgst die Entwicklung von Trends.
* Du hast eine kommunikative Persönlichkeit, sowie eine positive Ausstrahlung und ein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild.
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und verfügst von Vorteil über Kenntnisse einer weiteren Landessprache.

* Personalrabatte von 10 bis 25% auf alle Produktgruppen, inkl. Manora Restaurants und Food Märkte
* Aus- und Weiterbildungsprogramme für alle Stufen und Funktionen
* 5 bis 7 Wochen Ferien

* Sabbatical von 1-6 Monate ab Vollendung des 3. Anstellungsjahres möglich
* Firmeneigene Pensionskasse mit sehr solidem Deckungsgrad und überdurchschnittlicher Verzinsung des Sparguthabens
